test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The bar graph given below shows the expenditure of two companies L and M in different years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6132cdece3a86c299d3fb5df80270cb6ce1490fbb4d46f69a013bbc0d5041663.png] 

Which of the following statement is correct?

I. The expenditure of company L in Y2 is 33.33 percent of the expenditure of M in year Y3.

II. The expenditure of company M in year Y5 is 100 percent of the expenditure of L in year Y4.
solution:
**Calculation:**

**Statement I:**

The expenditure of company L in Y2 = 400

The expenditure of company M in Y3 = 600

Percentage of the expenditure of company L in Y2 to the expenditure of M in year Y3 = 400/600 × 100 = 66.66%

Statement I is wrong.

**Statement II:**

The expenditure of company M in year Y5 = 300
